doc: Approved reply refs for reply_due product/dispute parts (FABLE RULING [key=product-dispute-refs]; refs authored by r5 under fable-copy-1031-r5, 18:5xZ). scripts/credit_review/reply_ref_picker.py maps a customer part to exactly one ref in `refs` (model, judge-only) or a coded outcome: ack_no_reply_needed, jan_review (+ dispute_ref for a dispute over someone else's work), unanswered_by_code. The GATE posts the approved copy byte-for-byte as 5763097 (--reply-due --copy <ref>) and refuses when the ref's send_time_fact is not true. Adding a ref is a reviewed edit (r5).

fable-copy-1031-r5/q.class: asks for the status or timing of a credit request, or just nudges ('any update?', 'why so long', 'pending'). The gate sends the coded status line instead when an open request exists

fable-copy-1031-r5/r.class: streams, views, playlist or analytics numbers not updating or not matching the platform

fable-copy-1031-r5/s.class: a role or credit detail is wrong and they want the right role added (NOT a request to remove a credit)

fable-copy-1031-r5/t.class: a role or credit is not showing on their profile

fable-copy-1031-r5/u.class: a plaque title or plaque ordering question

fable-copy-1031-r5/v.class: how to add credits, or how to show all their credits

fable-copy-1031-r5/w.class: merging profiles or a duplicate profile

fable-copy-1031-r5/x.class: a plan, seat or cancel question (NOT a charge dispute, a refund or 'charged but inactive')

fable-copy-1031-r5/y.class: why a credit request was rejected or a credit removed

fable-copy-1030-r5/i.class: they sent a link, a detail, a document or proof (an answer to our ask), with no other question

dispute_ref.doc: coded, never chosen by the model: a dispute over someone else's work maps here; the gate posts it only when the row is literally in Jan's review list
